result.title: RecGroupMemory: Feedback-Aware Cohort Memory for E-Commerce Recommendation
result.summary: Cohort memory can support LLM-based recommendation planning through group-level user profiles and advice. As outcome feedback becomes available, this guidance may need to be updated while preserving the underlying observations. We present RecGroupMemory, a workflow that provides this memory to an orchestration LLM and separates memory construction from feedback-based revision. It uses feedback from the previous day to revise decision guidance, while validation checks keep selected source values unchanged. Online comparisons were conducted among Taobao users with low purchasing power selected by the business team. Relative to a no-memory baseline, memory without feedback and memory with feedback showed increases of 1.58% and 1.78%, respectively, in the number of guided transaction users.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 RecGroupMemory：用群体级用户画像与建议构建「cohort memory」提供给编排 LLM，并把记忆构建与基于次日反馈的修订分开，修订时通过校验保持原始观测值不变；在淘宝低购买力用户上做在线对比，带反馈记忆相对无记忆基线提升约 1.78%。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「原始观测与可修订决策指导分离、反馈只改指导不改源值」的做法可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态随反馈更新而不污染视觉证据提供概念类比，可供核查；但属电商推荐应用，无视觉输入与显式 latent 推理。
